name: Linen
description: Linen or linen blends: a matte, slightly coarse woven fabric with visible slubs (uneven thicker threads) and lots of soft creases. Looks airy and relaxed, often in natural or light colours.

name: Crochet / open knit
description: Hand-crochet or open, holey knits where you can see through the fabric between loops or stitches - granny squares, lacy crochet tops, open-weave summer knits.

name: Broderie / eyelet
description: Cotton with small cut-out holes edged in stitching forming flowers or scallops (broderie anglaise / eyelet) - crisp, summery and usually white or pastel.

name: Seersucker
description: Lightweight cotton with a puckered, crinkly texture in stripes or checks that stands slightly away from the body - a classic summer fabric.

name: Velvet
description: Velvet or velour: a soft, dense, short pile with a rich sheen that changes colour as the light catches it - plush and luxurious-looking.

name: Corduroy
description: Cotton with raised parallel ridges (wales) running down the fabric - fine needlecord to chunky jumbo cord.

name: Tweed / boucle
description: Thick, textured woollen weaves: tweed (rough, flecked with several colours, often herringbone or check) or bouclé (nubbly, looped yarn surface).

name: Chunky knit
description: Thick, heavy knitwear with big visible stitches - cable knits, chunky ribs, Fair Isle, hand-knit-looking jumpers and cardigans.

name: Wool / felted
description: Smooth or brushed woven wool and wool-felt - coat wool, melton, flannel, felted pieces; dense, matte and warm-looking without a visible knit stitch.

name: Shearling / fleece
description: Fluffy, warm pile fabrics: shearling, sherpa, teddy and polar fleece - textured, soft and insulating.

name: Faux fur
description: Long, shaggy or plush fur-like pile (real or faux) covering the piece.

name: Denim
description: Denim and chambray: sturdy diagonal-weave cotton, usually blue or black, with visible twill lines, fading and top-stitching.

name: Cotton / plain woven
description: Everyday woven cottons and similar plain fabrics: poplin, oxford, twill, chino, canvas, cotton voile - smooth, matte and crisp. The default for a woven fabric that isn't clearly linen, denim or a seasonal fabric.

name: Jersey
description: Stretchy knitted t-shirt fabric - cotton jersey, ribbed jersey, modal, sweatshirt fleece-back - smooth with no visible knit stitches; drapes and stretches.

name: Fine knit
description: Thin, smooth knitwear with small, flat stitches - merino, cashmere, cotton or viscose knits; fine jumpers, cardigans and knit tops.

name: Satin / silky
description: Smooth fabrics with a sheen or soft fluid drape - satin, silk, charmeuse, chiffon, georgette, crepe de chine and similar silky synthetics.

name: Leather / faux leather
description: Leather or faux leather (PU, pleather) - smooth or grained, matte or shiny.

name: Suede
description: Suede, nubuck or faux suede - a soft, matte, brushed surface with a slight nap.

name: Sequins / metallic
description: Sequins, glitter, lamé, foil and metallic fabrics that sparkle or shine all over.

name: Technical / nylon
description: Technical and synthetic outdoor fabrics - nylon, polyester shell, waterproof coatings, sportswear and quilted puffer fabric.
